correctness.rationale: The p- and 2^s-cyclotomic fields are linearly disjoint, so Φ_p is irreducible over Q(ζ_{2^s}); a Fourier zero forces equality of p grouped sums, and proper support supplies an empty group. For a≠0 the fibers of ax²+bx are fixed point c=-b/(2a) plus pairs {c±t}; a vanishing sum forces equal-exponent opposite coefficients in each occupied pair, and no nonzero linear frequency has a zero. A nonempty proper R has at most one reflection centre, proving empty/origin/L_c trichotomy. At (0,0), Φ_{2^s}(T)=T^{q/2}+1 forces matching opposite phase occupancies n_j=n_{j+q/2}; their multinomial count is A_{q,r}. Unique symmetric supports number p*C((p-1)/2,r), with q^r line assignments each. The q=4 simplification is Vandermonde: A_{4,r}=C(2r,r)^2. Independent sympy-cyclotomic quotient checks reproduced every actual Fourier zero for 2,100 cases at (p,q)=(5,4) with 1≤k≤4, 938 cases at (7,2) with 1≤k≤4, and 256 assignments on R=(0,1,3,5) at (7,4), all matching the predicted zero geometry and class counts. The original CHECK.py was read and its stated total 45,188 cases and 1,528,052 Fourier evaluations are arithmetically consistent, but its full run was not repeated. The infinite claim rests on the proof, not those checks.
